source_text: **Definition 9.1.2.** A **complete system of orthogonal idempotents** in a unital algebra $B$ is a collection of elements $e_1, \ldots, e_n \in B$ such that $e_i e_j = \delta_{ij} e_i$ and $\sum_{i=1}^n e_i = 1$.
